VBO:0201178.summary: Raptor Sarabi Kennel describes a guardian affectionate toward its family but aggressive toward unfamiliar beings, with training possible even though it calls the dog less readily trainable. The keeper traces Sarabis to Sarab in Iran. A 2011 study placed this working mastiff ecotype among those of the Persian Plateau and pictured a guard dog in northwest Iran.
